title: Cross-representation mechanics of genetic-programming search: code, data and results
description: Code, data and results of a preregistered study comparing genetic programming with exact, size-ordered blind search in real-valued symbolic regression and Boolean synthesis: grammars and exhaustive enumerators, tree GP, Cartesian GP and Operon runs, every run record, the registered analyses and their outputs, and a script that checks the code and data against the versions registered on OSF.
